text:
ana: quick flag — customer onboarding failed: REST /v1/models/eval:run accepts "input_batch" array but JS SDK only exposes "input" single-item param. customer tried to pass multiple prompts and got a 400 from SDK layer.

kevin: can you paste the REST shape and your SDK call?

ana: REST curl that worked:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/eval:run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"eval-1","input_batch":["q1","q2"]}'
```

ana: JS SDK call that fails:
```js
await client.models.evalRun({ model: 'eval-1', input: ['q1','q2'] })
// throws: InvalidParameter: expected string for input
```

tori: that looks like a parameter name drift. openapi had moved to input_batch but SDK generator maps only single param alias. we changed the server to accept both names for backwards compat but SDK still validates client-side.

kevin: root cause: validator layer in sdk-js enforces types based on old schema (input: string). generator update didn't update runtime validators. we also accidentally added a camelCase <> snake_case mismatch (inputBatch vs input_batch) which the SDK glosses over.

ana: temporaries: using REST directly or calling client.models.evalRun({ model:'eval-1', input: 'q1' }) in a loop. both suck for onboarding.

ci-bot: created failing test redwood-js/tests/integration/eval_batch_test.js on main.

kevin: plan: (1) update generator to include both input_batch and input aliases and regenerate bindings; (2) update runtime validators to accept array/string union where openapi allows oneOf; (3) add e2e that posts batch via SDK to staging. I'll open PR today.

tori: also add mapping layer so SDK auto-normalizes camelCase/snake_case in body keys to avoid silent mismatches.

devx-bot: issue RNF-2563 created in redwood-js-sdk: "models.eval:run param drift & validator mismatch".

ana: timeline? customer kickoff is tomorrow morning.

kevin: will try to get a small hotfix patch (v0.8.3) with validator relax and alias mapping. if not ready, we'll update sample-onboard to call REST and document the workaround.

ana: confirmed workaround to call REST works; filing docs PR to note batch param and SDK caveat.

devx-bot: thread archived.
